title: "It never arrived"
story: ShopBot pays FreshMart INR 1,250 for Asha's weekly groceries, with a cart check that matched. Asha tells her bank the groceries never arrived. The Guard builds the pack, but says openly it is not strong: it knows what was agreed and paid, not what was delivered.

steps.instruction: Order this week's groceries: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.
steps.item: Weekly groceries: milk, eggs, bread, fruit

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order this week's groceries, please: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart is INR 1,250. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: My groceries never arrived. I've disputed the FreshMart charge.

what_to_notice: Mixed at best, by design: the Guard holds no evidence of delivery, so the pack names `fulfilment_evidence` as missing and asks for the shop's own delivery proof. The not-as-described reason (Visa 13.3, Mastercard 4853) is treated the same way.
